title: Siege of Naples (1528)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Naples (1528)", at revision 1370743875, opens: "The siege of Naples was a siege of the Italian city of Naples in 1528 during the War of the League of Cognac." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16529030, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1528 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
